data.summary: Shape complete via autonomous /goal: deterministic bad-case attribution (5 categories, rule-ordered), annotation-joined trace pipeline producing review artifacts + clusters, thin CLI, no auto-apply and no writes outside output dir.

Verified end-to-end: REJECT-unknown → registry-alias candidate; CLARIFY matched → extraction candidate; output outside repo handled; full suite 1696 passed/1 skipped/2 xfailed.
